channel.title: Attacotti
channel.description: Scotland's way home runs through Europe.

item.title: At least 20 migrants dead after two boats found off southern Crete
item.description: The Greek coastguard rescued 46 people from the two boats and two people are missing, while Frontex teams picked up dozens more on Monday. The deputy migration minister said cooperation with eastern Libya was gone and flows had increased as a result.

item.title: Ten JEF countries sign naval partnership pact to deter Russian threats
item.description: The British-led agreement commits the navies of Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the UK to interchangeable forces, commanded from Northwood in London. Norway's Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre called it a response to American calls for allies to carry more of the burden.
